ukmt-jmc-2024-01.prompt:

$$2+2 \qquad 2\times2 \qquad 2-2 \qquad 2\div2 \qquad 2^2$$

ukmt-jmc-2024-03.prompt: Gill is 36 this year. In which year will her age next be a square?

ukmt-jmc-2024-04.prompt: A drink is made by mixing one part of cordial with four parts of water. What percentage of the drink is cordial?

ukmt-jmc-2024-06.prompt: Which of the following has the same remainder when divided by 3 as it does when divided by 4?

ukmt-jmc-2024-07.prompt:

What fraction of the area of the large square has been shaded?

Skye has half as many pens as Ishaa. Ana has twice as many pens as Skye.

What fraction of all their pens does Skye have?

What is the size of angle $UPT$?

ukmt-jmc-2024-10.prompt:
In Fred's field there are some humans and some horses.

There are 25 heads in total and 60 legs in total.

What is the difference between the number of humans and the number of horses?

ukmt-jmc-2024-11.prompt:

What is the perimeter, in cm, of the hexagon?

$$\begin{array}{r} 3\,y \\ \times\;\; 4\,y\,y \\ \hline 1\,y\,7\,7\,y \end{array}$$

What is the value of $y$?

ukmt-jmc-2024-13.prompt:

$$\square\,\square \div \square + \square = \square$$

Which number should come immediately after the division sign?

ukmt-jmc-2024-16.prompt:

Approximately how many of these frogs, placed end to end, would be needed to make a line 1 metre long?

ukmt-jmc-2024-17.prompt:

What fraction of the area of rectangle $PQRS$ is shaded?

ukmt-jmc-2024-23.prompt: The area of a square is six times the area of a rectangle with a length half that of the square and a width 6 cm less than the width of the square. What is the perimeter of the square?

| United | 0 | 2 | 1 | 3 | 6 |
